name: wifi_rod_telemetry_head
description: Control-rod head with two WIFI taps (command/position channels), INWR+PSCN drive pins, a 1px PSTN stroke through INSL into a COAL moderator block. Repeat at 10px pitch; give each head its own channel pair so the bank reads as a telemetry ladder.
why: Save 3209222 top bank x=399..469 (10px pitch): each head has WIFI at (0,0) on channels 14..21 and a second WIFI at (4,4) on channels 4..11 -- exact +100C steps per rod, i.e. a rod-position ladder. PSTN runs y=41-71 (31px) into a COAL(moderator) block at y=73+. Source WIFI cells are open on top/left; jacketed here with INSL (both WIFI stand at 100-1800C).
